eta cs (u * v) t = eta cs v t + eta cs u (v * t * v⁻¹)

theorem QOU.Machinery.CoxeterParabolic.wordProd_alternatingWord_odd_add {B : Type u_1} {W : Type u_2} [Group W] {M : CoxeterMatrix B} (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (i j : B) (n m : ℕ) :
cs.wordProd (CoxeterSystem.alternatingWord i j (2 * n + 1 + 2 * m)) = (cs.simple j * cs.simple i) ^ m * cs.wordProd (CoxeterSystem.alternatingWord i j (2 * n + 1))

theorem QOU.Machinery.CoxeterParabolic.wordProd_alternatingWord_two_mul {B : Type u_1} {W : Type u_2} [Group W] {M : CoxeterMatrix B} (cs : CoxeterSystem M W) (i j : B) (m : ℕ) :
cs.wordProd (CoxeterSystem.alternatingWord i j (2 * m)) = (cs.simple i * cs.simple j) ^ m

(CoxeterSystem.alternatingWord i j (2 * m)).reverse = CoxeterSystem.alternatingWord j i (2 * m)

theorem QOU.Machinery.CoxeterParabolic.alternatingWord_odd_succ_succ {B : Type u_1} (i j : B) (n : ℕ) :

theorem QOU.Machinery.CoxeterParabolic.alternatingWord_two_mul_succ {B : Type u_1} (i j : B) (m : ℕ) :
CoxeterSystem.alternatingWord i j (2 * (m + 1)) = i :: j :: CoxeterSystem.alternatingWord i j (2 * m)
